faces.name: Aeon Chronicler
faces.oracleText:
Aeon Chronicler's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in your hand.
Suspend X—{X}{3}{U}. X can't be 0.
Whenever a time counter is removed from this card while it's exiled, draw a card.

faces.name: Aeon Engine
faces.oracleText:
This artifact enters tapped.
{T}, Exile this artifact: Reverse the game's turn order. (For example, if play had proceeded clockwise around the table, it now goes counterclockwise.)
